info.title: Agen
info.description: Example MCP server of NICE (auth mode nice_token). Its tools call inventaris and pengiriman on behalf of the user with tokens from token exchange. Every request needs a NICE access token for the audience agen.

x-nice-roles.name: User
x-nice-roles.description: Use the agent through an MCP client

BearerAuth.description: Access token of NICE requested with the scope nice:aud:agen.

post.description: JSON-RPC messages of the Model Context Protocol (initialize, tools/list, tools/call). Every tool exchanges the user's token for a token of its target service.

401.description: Missing or invalid token; WWW-Authenticate names the resource metadata
